title: Especialista SEO/GEO con perfil de Desarrollo para E-commerce
description:
About the job

 Estamos buscando Especialista SEO/GEO con perfil de Desarrollo para E-commerce

3 a 6 meses por proyecto




En Envases XENA estamos fortaleciendo nuestro Canal Directo de E-commerce, desarrollado sobre Shopify, y buscamos una persona que combine conocimientos de SEO técnico, desarrollo web y nuevas estrategias de posicionamiento en motores generativos.

 Importante: Esta posición está enfocada en la ejecución de proyectos específicos de E-commerce, con una duración estimada de 3 a 6 meses por proyecto, de acuerdo con los objetivos y entregables establecidos.

 ¿Cuál será tu objetivo?

Optimizar nuestro ecosistema digital en Shopify para mejorar la visibilidad, posicionamiento y adquisición orgánica del Canal Directo, tanto en buscadores tradicionales como Google, como en motores generativos y experiencias de búsqueda impulsadas por IA.

La posición requiere una persona que no solamente identifique oportunidades de mejora, sino que pueda implementarlas directamente en Shopify.

 Principales responsabilidades

• Realizar auditorías técnicas del sitio: indexación, velocidad, arquitectura de URLs, datos estructurados, etc.

 • Ejecutar estrategias de SEO técnico, OnPage y OffPage.

 • Implementar mejoras directamente en el código/tema de Shopify.

 • Optimizar contenido para buscadores tradicionales y motores generativos.

 • Definir y ejecutar estrategias de contenido orgánico para blog y landing pages.

 • Monitorear posicionamiento, tráfico orgánico y su contribución a conversión.

 • Mantenerse actualizado en GEO/AEO y nuevas tendencias de búsqueda generativa.

 • Optimizar la presencia orgánica en redes sociales y trabajar de manera coordinada con los equipos de Analítica y Desarrollo.

 • Participar en proyectos específicos con objetivos y entregables definidos en periodos de 3 a 6 meses.

 ¿Qué buscamos?

• +3 años de experiencia en SEO técnico, OnPage y OffPage, idealmente en E-commerce.

 • Experiencia trabajando con Shopify y capacidad para realizar implementaciones técnicas.

 • Conocimientos de HTML, CSS y JavaScript básico-intermedio.

 • Experiencia con Liquid/Shopify, PHP/WordPress/WooCommerce y/o VTEX.

 • Manejo de Google Search Console, Ahrefs/Semrush y Screaming Frog.

 • Conocimiento de GEO/AEO y optimización para motores generativos.

 • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de desarrollo y analítica.

 • Experiencia con SMO.

 Tecnologías y herramientas

Shopify · Liquid · Google Search Console · GA4 · Ahrefs/Semrush · Screaming Frog · Metricool · HTML · CSS · JavaScript · WooCommerce · VTEX

 Zona: Col. Portales Sur

 Horario: Lunes a viernes de 9:00 a 18:00 hrs + 2 sábados al mes

 Sueldo: $17,000 a $18,000 MXN

Si eres de esas personas que no solamente detectan qué está fallando, sino que saben cómo implementarlo, y tienes experiencia real en E-commerce y Shopify, nos interesa conocerte.

📩 Envía tu CV por LinkedIn o comparte tu perfil por WhatsApp al 55 7504 0407.

#Vacante #Ecommerce #Shopify #SEO #GEO #AEO #SEOJobs #MarketingDigital #DesarrolloWeb #SEOtécnico #EmpleoMéxico

About the job

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. You will have responsibility for partnering with a small number of assigned accounts, maintaining a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their overall technical and operational health and realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer's key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.

As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

Your Impact


Function as the Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration (and needs) of the customer.
Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for orchestration of all Signature deliverables, experience, and renewal, and expansion.
Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.
Help your customers achieve their business goals and outcomes on the Salesforce Marketing platform by:
Coordinating the completion of the Signature Success catalog of services as required for your customer
Providing timely, proactive Salesforce feature guidance based on the areas of interest for your customer
Acting as an advisor to your customers for the adoption of new features of Salesforce’s annual release schedules and identifying potential challenges and risks to your customer's implementation
Communicate the value of Signature Success. Be accountable for ensuring all collaborators understand this value so that customers continue to renew Signature Success.
Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
Internal Relationship Building: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.
Evolution of Roles: Anticipate and adapt to role changes per evolving Salesforce needs.

Minimum Skills


Experienced professional with 5+ years of relevant industry expertise in Technical Customer Success, Customer Success Manager, SaaS platform use or project leadership, Technology Consulting, Technology Solutions Development, Technical and/or Solutions Architecture.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills with demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively at all levels of the organization, including executive and C-level.
Skills for both analyzing technical concepts and translating them into business terms and for mapping business requirements into technical features.
Ability to explain complex technical concepts in business-friendly terms to customers, then explain customer needs to internal partners.
Coordinate and work closely with high volume events and/or key events for the customer.
Experience leading efforts of cross-functional teams to facilitate resolution or disposition of customer needs or projects.


Preferred Requirements


+2 years in Salesforce Ecosystem.
Salesforce product certifications are a plus (Marketing Associate, Marketing Cloud Administrator, Salesforce Certified Associate, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist, Marketing Cloud Email Specialist).
Deep understanding of Marketing Cloud, marketing automation, personalization, advertising, and/or marketing platforms.
Deep understanding of Digital Marketing processes, challenges and trends
Knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud features and applications and able to articulate the value and how a Customer can benefit from Signature Success for Marketing Cloud
Knowledge of Salesforce product suite and features, capabilities, best use, and how to deploy, including knowledge of the Salesforce platform and ecosystem.
Degree or equivalent experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the strengths you'll need for the role (e.g. demonstrated behaviors in previous jobs, that align to role needs such as extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)


This position will require you to work from your local Salesforce office 3 to 4 days a week.

Volunteer Opportunities

Have you heard of our 1:1:1 model, focused on giving back to the community? The success in giving back has helped us and our Trailblazer community become a leader in philanthropy, culture, and innovation. We are one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies, according to Forbes, we are #1 in PEOPLE’s Top 15 Companies that Care, and are on Fortune’s Change the World list. Values create value. description:
About the job

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

El Customer Marketing Coordinator es el líder estratégico responsable de maximizar el crecimiento rentable y la participación de mercado en el canal de autoservicios, integrando la estrategia de marca, la ejecución impecable en punto de venta y la gestión financiera (GTN). El Customer Marketing Coordinator funge como business partner clave para ventas y áreas comerciales, anticipando tendencias, generando planes de cliente alineados con la visión de la compañía y asegurando que cada iniciativa comercial se traduzca en resultados medibles, sostenibles y escalables.

Principales responsabilidades: 

Definir la estrategia de ejecución comercial por cliente de autoservicios (Walmart, Soriana, Chedraui, etc.), asegurando alineación con los objetivos de la compañía

Traducir planes de marketing y category en tácticas adaptadas al canal, garantizando relevancia y diferenciación en el punto de venta

Asegurar planes anuales de negocio (JBPs) sólidos y alineados con prioridades estratégicas - Administrar y optimizar el uso del presupuesto comercial (descuentos, promociones, trade terms) para maximizar rentabilidad y eficiencia

Monitorear inversión por cliente y por marca, asegurando rentabilidad y visibilidad mensual de GTN: forecast vs. real, desvíos y oportunidades

Trabajar de la mano con el equipo de Key Accounts como socio estratégico, asegurando consistencia entre la estrategia de cliente y la ejecución en punto de venta

Proveer insights, herramientas y soporte en negociaciones clave con clientes para fortalecer relaciones y resultados comerciales

Desarrollar guías de ejecución por cliente, alineadas al modelo de Perfect Store, y coordinar actividades promocionales y planes de visibilidad en tiendas

Medir el impacto de iniciativas comerciales y recomendar mejoras continuas para escalar resultados

Analizar desempeño del canal (sell-in, sell-out, share, margen) y proveer recomendaciones basadas en data para mejorar ejecución y ROI de la inversión

Preparar reportes ejecutivos para Dirección Comercial y Marketing, asegurando visibilidad clara y oportuna de resultados y aprendizajes

¿Por qué TÚ? 

Tus calificaciones: 


Licenciatura en Administración, Marketing, Economía o afín
EMBA o MBA o Estudios de Posgrado en áreas afines es deseable
Experiencia de 6+ años en roles estratégicos en Category Management, Shopper y/o KAM
Experiencia con manejo de materiales en PDV
Inglés Intermedio/Avanzado
Conocimiento Avanzado de Excel/Office 365.
Conocimiento de SCINTILLA
Conocimiento Avanzado de habilidades comerciales y negociación.
Pensamiento Estratégico y Analítico: Capacidad para pensar estratégicamente, analizar datos comerciales, KPIs financeiros, tendencias del mercado y shopper insights para desarrollar estrategias y iniciativas que impulsen el crecimiento.
Gestión de Stakeholders: Excelentes habilidades de comunicación e interpersonales, con la capacidad de construir y mantener relaciones sólidas con stakeholders internos y externos.
Sólido entendimiento categorias, Trade marketing y ejecución omnicanal.
Cómodo trabajando en entornos de ritmo rápido con agilidad y autonomía en la toma de decisiones.



¿Sientes que este puede ser tu próximo paso de carrera? ¡Aplica ahora! 

 

Job Posting End Date

2026-10-16

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. description:
About the job

About Turn




Turn is a venture-backed B2B software company built for the realities of high-volume hiring. Our platform runs pre-employment background checks and continuous monitoring, and integrates directly into the systems employers already hire with — so teams in hospitality, staffing, construction, healthcare, and real estate can screen candidates fast without giving up compliance. We’re a small, fully remote team that moves quickly and ships real things.





About the Role




We’re looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Engineer to own our full-funnel demand engine and turn the traffic and buying signals we already generate into qualified demos and pipeline.




You’ll sit at the intersection of performance marketing, marketing operations, conversion optimization, and analytics, building and running the systems that move a prospect from first touch to booked meeting. This is a builder’s role: you’ll spend your days in the ad platforms, the CRM, the analytics tools, and the page builder, shipping changes and measuring their impact on qualified-demo volume and pipeline.




What You’ll Do





Paid acquisition: Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns (Google Ads — Performance Max and Search, LinkedIn), architecting campaign structure, audience targeting, and conversion-event mapping so spend optimizes toward booked demos and pipeline rather than clicks, with clean, server-imported conversion tracking (enhanced/offline conversions from the CRM).


Conversion rate optimization: Build and A/B test dedicated demo landing pages, landing pages, forms, and CTAs that turn visitors into meetings, including persona-aware routing (buyer vs. candidate vs. partner) across the site, and own the on-site demo path.


Marketing operations & RevOps: Own the full lead lifecycle and the automation behind it — CRM workflows, lifecycle-stage instrumentation, lead scoring and routing, and the visitor-signal-to-outbound engine across HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Duo, and Zapier. Build and scale the loop that turns identified in-market website visitors into timely, signal-based 1:1 outreach.


Email deliverability & infrastructure: Own outbound sending infrastructure — mailbox and domain strategy, warm-up and rotation, pre-send verification, and deliverability health — so outreach lands in the inbox and protects the primary domain’s reputation.


Analytics & reporting: Build and own the measurement layer end to end — define the key conversion events, GA4, UTM governance, conversion validation — and build the dashboards that tie marketing activity to pipeline and revenue (Mode).


Conversion copywriting: Write the ad, landing-page, and signal-based outbound copy that drives response.









What You’ll Need





Hands-on experience across growth marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, or revenue operations — ideally in B2B SaaS. You’re a builder who works inside the tools, not only a strategist.


Real performance-marketing experience, especially Google Ads (including Performance Max and Search campaign structure), with a habit of optimizing toward CAC and pipeline instead of vanity metrics.


Fluency with a modern marketing / CRM automation stack (we use HubSpot, Amplemarket, RB2B, Intercom, Zapier, and Calendly; comparable tools like Salesforce, Marketo, or Make are fine).


Analytics chops: GA4, disciplined UTM and conversion tracking, and enough SQL / BI to build your own dashboards (we use Mode; Looker, Amplitude, or similar is fine).


CRO instincts and conversion copywriting ability.


A data-driven, experimental, self-directed way of working — you read the funnel, ship the fix, and measure the result.


Bilingual Spanish/English, with fluent written English.









This is our ideal profile, not a checklist. If you can do the work, we’d love to hear from you regardless of years or title.




Success Metrics (First 6–12 Months)





Growth in qualified demos and marketing-sourced pipeline, at flat or lower cost per acquisition.


Higher conversion rates across the funnel, from visitor to demo to booked meeting.


A larger share of best-fit (ICP) traffic reached and converted.


Strong outbound deliverability and healthy sending infrastructure across all domains.


A reliable weekly reporting cadence that ties marketing activity to pipeline.









Nice to Have





Experience in HR tech, workforce, background screening, or compliance-adjacent categories.


Account-based marketing (ABM) and audience segmentation.


Server-side, enhanced, or offline conversion tracking (e.g. CAPI).


Outbound email deliverability at scale — multi-domain/mailbox management, warm-up, and inbox placement.


Technical SEO and simple creative for ads and social.









Perks & Compensation





Competitive salary (base range shared early in the process)


Major medical health insurance


Paid time off


Remote work with occasional in-office training and in-person meetings

About the job

At AIG, we are reimagining the way we help customers to manage risk. Join us as an Integrated Marketing Specialist to play your part in that transformation. It’s an opportunity to grow your skills and experience as a valued member of the team.

Make Your Mark In Global Functions

Global Functions provide a wide range of services to the organization such as Business IT and Operations, Finance, Marketing & Communications, Security and Human Resources. Its teams play a vital role in ensuring we deliver for our customers and achieve our business goals.

The Integrated Marketing Specialist will support AIG Mexico and the Miami Facultative Desk by executing integrated marketing initiatives across digital channels and broker engagement activities. The role reports to the FAC Desk Marketing Lead with a dotted line to the Mexico Marketing Lead and works closely with commercial leaders across the region.

How you will create an impact



Execute digital and content marketing campaigns, social media, website updates, email communications and editorial calendars. 
Create engaging content, presentations and short-form videos aligned with AIG brand standards. 
Coordinate broker and client events in Mexico and regional Facultative markets, including logistics, vendors, budgets and post-event reporting. 
Partner with Distribution and business leaders to develop content marketing initiatives that support commercial priorities. 
Manage external agencies and suppliers, ensuring quality, consistency and on-time delivery. 
Track campaign and event performance, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement. 
Support broader Marketing & Communications initiatives as business priorities evolve. 


What You’ll Need To Succeed



Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising or related field. 
3-5 years of experience in B2B marketing with a strong focus on digital marketing and event management. 
Experience managing agencies, multiple stakeholders and simultaneous projects. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish. 
Advanced English language proficiency (participates in meetings with other countries), including speaking, reading, and writing. Fluency in English is required.
Strong organizational skills, creativity, commercial mindset and attention to detail. 
Knowledge of LinkedIn, Meta Business Suite, Canva, Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel. Experience with CRM platforms is desirable but not required. 


Success in the First 12 Months 



Deliver high-quality marketing support to Mexico and the Miami FAC Desk. 
Execute integrated campaigns aligned with business priorities. 
Coordinate successful broker and client events with measurable business impact. 
Become a trusted marketing partner for commercial stakeholders across both businesses. 


Ready to take your career to the next level? We would love to hear from you.

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

Enjoy Benefits That Take Care Of What Matters

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world

American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.

Welcome to a culture of inclusion

We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. We foster a culture of inclusion and belonging through learning, cultural awareness activities and Employee Resource Groups (ERGs). With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion. The talent of our people is one of AIG’s greatest assets, and we are honored that our drive for positive change has been recognized by numerous recent awards and accreditations.

AIG provides equal opportunity to all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender expression, national origin, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected categories.

AIG is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to job applicants and employees with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation, please send an email to candidatecare@aig.com.

skills: Support client updates and weekly reporting with accurate, on‑time inputs; explain results and next steps in plain language tied to goals.

Comfortable with GA4 and platform analytics; can turn data into clear next steps.
Strong communication and collaboration; confident handling client updates with support.
Advanced Excel/Sheets and presentation tools; Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
Growth support: Contribute to qualified reach, new‑customer acquisition, and revenue from Paid Social.

Audience and signal: Expand high‑intent audiences; improve pixel/CAPI/event health; fewer “limited learning” cases.
Innovation cadence: Deliver small, safe innovations (creative, audience, bidding, format) and record decisions and learnings.
Product/AI adoption: Pilot and adopt platform automation and Bliss Point‑guided optimizations with proven incremental impact.
Efficiency (guardrail): Maintain or improve CAC/ROAS while growing profitable volume.

About the job

Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Social Specialist, you will help build, launch, and improve Paid Social campaigns (primarily Meta; plus TikTok, Pinterest Performance+, Snapchat, Reddit as relevant) to grow new customers and revenue, while keeping efficiency on track. You’ll follow clear playbooks, turn performance and creative learnings into next actions, and try new ideas in controlled environments before wider rollout. You’ll partner closely with Creative, Analytics, Product/Bliss Point, and senior Channel Leads in your Pod, communicate clearly, and document what works so the team can reuse it. Support client updates and weekly reporting with accurate, on‑time inputs; explain results and next steps in plain language tied to goals.

Data & Measurement‑Driven


Monitor performance daily/weekly; build accurate recurring reports; run basic A/Bs with predefined success criteria and a simple read cadence; keep budgets and pacing healthy.
Maintain data quality using checklists (pixel/CAPI basics, event checks, UTMs/GA4 alignment); partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.


Owner Mindset


Manage a clear work queue; deliver on time; reduce rework and non‑converting spend (e.g., limit creative fatigue, de‑dupe overlapping audiences, avoid learning‑phase resets); close the loop with documented learnings.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone your craft, and embrace new tools and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Focus on outcomes, evidence, and simple explanations.
Culture of ownership: Move fast, cut waste, and own results end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications


2+ years in Paid Social execution with hands‑on builds, launches, pacing, and optimizations; strong familiarity with Meta Ads buying.

We operate on a flexible hybrid model, but we love seeing our team! For this role, we ask that you come into our great office in Reforma, CDMX, two days a week. This is an essential part of how we collaborate and connect, so candidates should be comfortable with this regular in-office commitment.

We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

About the job

Ubicación:

Guadalajara, Jalisco, México.

Descripción de la compañía.

Ferrero es una empresa familiar con una perspectiva verdaderamente mundial y progresista y marcas icónicas como Nutella®, Tic Tac®, Ferrero Rocher®, Raffaello®, Kinder Bueno® y Kinder Sorpresa®. El amor por nuestras marcas sigue creciendo al igual que lo hace nuestro alcance internacional. Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. Únete a nosotros, podrías ser uno de ellos.

Acerca del Rol:

Nos encontramos en búsqueda de una persona responsable, comprometida, con ganas de aprender y desarrollarse en el área de Marketing. Si tienes un perfil analítico, te gusta generar insights y colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios a partir de la interpretación de información para la creación de estrategias de Marcas ¡esta oportunidad puede ser interesante para ti!

Postúlate y podrás formar parte del equipo que hace de Ferrero un lugar extraordinario para trabajar.

Principales Responsabilidades:


Serás responsable de actualizar y realizar reportes. 
Darás seguimiento de tareas y pendientes del equipo. 
Serás responsable de participar en análisis de información de mercado y desempeño. 
Brindarás soporte en la descarga, actualización y seguimiento de información Nielsen u otras plataformas de interpretación de data. 
Darás soporte operativo para presentaciones y documentos internos.


Acerca de ti:


Estudiante de Lic. En Marketing, Administración, Negocios, Ingeniería Industrial o afín, a partir de 5to semestre (garantizar estatus activo de al menos un año).

Perfil proactivo, analítico (lógico-numérico), comunicación efectiva, organización, estructurado, atención al detalle y con enfoque a los resultados. 
Interés por aprender y desarrollarse en el área, en un entorno dinámico: desde la parte analítica, interpretación de data y generación de insights. 


Nuestros Beneficios y ventajas:

Carreras con cuidado integrado: descubre nuestros beneficios aquí.

Acerca de Ferrero:

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com.

¿Cómo ser exitoso en el rol y en Ferrero?

Consumidores, calidad y servicio son la clave de todo cuanto hacemos. Así pues, para cosechar el éxito en Ferrero, deberás orientarte al consumidor y al producto tanto como nosotros: dedicarte a lograr buenos resultados para los clientes en todo el mundo.

DE&I en Ferrero:

Ferrero se compromete a construir una cultura diversa e inclusiva donde todos los empleados se sientan bienvenidos, valorados y tengan las mismas oportunidades. Creemos que todos nuestros empleados tienen el mismo talento, cada uno a su manera. Al fomentar la curiosidad y las habilidades naturales de nuestros empleados, les proporcionamos, generación tras generación, los medios para alcanzar el éxito personal y profesional, permitiéndoles forjar su trayectoria en Ferrero. La diversidad de nuestros talentos es lo que hace que nuestro entorno laboral sea multicultural, innovador y altamente gratificante. Descubre más aquí.

title: Senior Media Buyer / Paid Media Specialist
description:
About the job

Ethnik Living

Ethnik Living is a furniture and home decor brand creating distinctive pieces for thoughtfully

designed spaces. We’re looking for a Senior Media Buyer / Paid Media Specialist to own

campaign execution, improve customer acquisition, and scale profitable growth.

This is a hands-on role for someone with deep expertise in Meta Ads Manager and Google

Ads, strong creative judgment, and experience managing substantial budgets for DTC brands in

the US market. You’ll work across paid acquisition and retention, connecting advertising

performance with creative strategy, brand positioning, and the customer journey.

What You’ll Do

Paid Media Strategy & Execution

● Own the setup, launch, management, and optimization of campaigns across Meta,

Google, TikTok, AppLovin, and Pinterest.

● Bring expert-level execution to Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, including campaign

structure, audience strategy, bidding, testing, and scaling.

● Build and manage media plans, allocate budgets across channels, and adjust spend

based on performance and business priorities.

● Manage prospecting and retargeting strategies that acquire new customers efficiently

and support profitable growth.

● Stay current with platform changes, advertising formats, and new opportunities worth

testing.

Creative Strategy & Brand Direction

● Work closely with the creative team to develop concepts, hooks, messaging, offers, and

formats that drive results.

● Translate performance data into clear creative briefs and actionable feedback.

● Build a structured creative testing roadmap and identify what works, why it works, and

what to test next.

● Understand how brand positioning, visual direction, and storytelling influence advertising

performance.

● Keep campaigns consistent with Ethnik Living’s identity while adapting creative to each

platform.

Email & SMS Marketing

● Use Klaviyo and Postscript to build, execute, and optimize email and SMS campaigns

and automated flows.

● Develop segmentation and testing strategies that improve conversion, repeat purchases,

and customer lifetime value.

● Coordinate retention activity with paid campaigns, product launches, and promotional

calendars.

● Monitor performance, list health, and deliverability, and turn findings into practical

improvements.

Performance Analysis & Optimization

● Track acquisition costs, ROAS, blended marketing efficiency, conversion rates, and

contribution margin.

● Evaluate results using both platform reporting and overall business performance.

● Identify opportunities across ads, landing pages, product pages, and offers to improve

conversion.

● Maintain clear reporting on results, budget pacing, learnings, and next steps.

● Check campaign settings, tracking, links, offers, and creative before launch, and resolve

issues quickly.

What You Must Bring

● At least 3 years of hands-on paid media buying experience.

● Previous experience working with a DTC brand selling to the US market.

● Both agency experience and in-house brand experience are required.

● A proven track record of personally managing advertising budgets exceeding

US$250,000 per month, with responsibility for allocation, optimization, and results.

● Advanced, hands-on expertise in both Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.

● Hands-on experience with TikTok Ads, AppLovin, and Pinterest Ads.

● Practical experience using Klaviyo and Postscript for email and SMS marketing.

● Strong knowledge of creative strategy, creative direction, copy, and branding.

● Strong analytical skills and an understanding of ecommerce economics, attribution, and

profitable scaling.

● The ability to take ownership, communicate clearly, and turn insights into action.

Especially Valuable

● Experience in home decor, furniture, interiors, or closely related categories.

● Experience marketing higher-consideration products with longer purchase journeys.

● Familiarity with Shopify, GA4, and third-party attribution tools.

● Experience with incrementality testing and measuring the impact of spend beyond

platform-reported ROAS.

How to Apply

Apply through LinkedIn with your résumé and a brief overview of the US DTC brands you’ve

worked with, the monthly budgets you’ve personally managed, and examples of results you’ve

driven. Please highlight your agency and in-house experience, along with any work in home

decor or furniture.

description:
About the job

About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.

About The Role

The Insights & Reliability Engineering team builds data-intensive software systems that help Crunchyroll proactively detect, investigate, and improve reliability across user-facing experiences, including device QoE, payments, partner integrations, and core product journeys.

As a Senior Engineer, you will build, operate, and evolve tools, telemetry workflows, alerting systems, and operational insight platforms that turn high-volume product and platform data into actionable reliability signals. Your work will help engineering teams identify regressions, understand customer impact, improve signal quality, and drive systemic fixes before issues meaningfully affect users.

This is a software engineering role for someone who enjoys working close to data and production systems. The ideal candidate has strong coding fundamentals, SQL/data fluency, experience building reliable tools or data workflows, and the production instincts to solve ambiguous production problems across systems. As a senior engineer, you will help shape technical direction, define scalable operational practices, and influence cross-functional partners across engineering, product, data, and partner-facing teams.

What You Will Be Doing


Build, operate, and evolve reliability tooling, telemetry workflows, alerting systems, dashboards, and automation that help teams detect and investigate customer-impacting issues.
Transform high-volume product, device, payment, partner, and platform telemetry into reliable operational signals for anomaly detection, alerting, debugging, and leadership visibility.
Use SQL, logs, metrics, dashboards, and product context to identify anomalies, baseline performance, validate hypotheses, and uncover patterns that drive reliability improvements.
Lead cross-team improvements to monitoring, alerting, signal quality, triage workflows, and operational automation, defining scalable patterns that reduce time to detection and resolution.
Participate in incident response, alert review, and production issue investigation for device, payment, and partner-related issues, with a focus on improving the systems and processes that make future issues easier to detect and resolve.
Work with internal service owners and external technical partners when reliability issues span device, payment, or partner ecosystems, with a focus on improving the software systems, telemetry, and ownership paths that make future issues easier to detect and resolve.
Collaborate with engineering, product, data, analytics, and partner teams to drive systemic fixes, postmortem learnings, and long-term reliability improvements.
Help set technical direction for reliability tooling and investigation workflows within your area, establishing patterns for telemetry quality, debugging, and operational readiness.
Communicate technical findings, customer impact, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, and/or 8+ years of practical engineering experience.
Strong coding skills, with Python preferred; experience with similar modern programming languages is also welcome if you can ramp up quickly in Python-based workflows.
Strong SQL skills and experience working with high-volume event, telemetry, product, or operational datasets.
Experience building, testing, deploying, and maintaining production-quality software, internal tools, data workflows, automation, or observability systems.
Experience with data-processing systems, analytics engineering workflows, reliability tooling, alerting systems, or operational insight platforms.
Ability to debug ambiguous production problems using data, logs, metrics, dashboards, code, system behavior, and product context.
Experience working across data, observability, and analytics platforms, such as Databricks/Spark for data processing, Airflow/dbt for workflow orchestration and modeling, Datadog/Grafana for monitoring, and Tableau/Mixpanel/Mux for product or experience analytics.
Experience defining scalable operational processes, improving signal quality, reducing alert noise, and turning repeated manual workflows into durable automation.
Experience in reliability engineering, SRE, incident response, support engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, or operational tooling roles.
Comfortable working with consumer device, payment, partner integration, or distributed system domains.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Data, Analytics, and partner-facing teams.
Experience leading ambiguous, cross-system initiatives and aligning multiple teams around technical priorities, operational tradeoffs, and durable reliability improvements.
Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools, including agentic workflows where appropriate, to accelerate investigation, implementation, testing, or automation, with strong judgment around correctness, maintainability, security, and production safety.
Clear communicator, capable of translating technical findings, reliability risks, and customer impact for broad audiences.


You Might Be a Great Fit If You...


Enjoy building and evolving software, data workflows, and observability systems that make complex production behavior easier to understand and improve.
Are fluent in both code and data, and like using telemetry, SQL, logs, metrics, and product context to solve ambiguous problems.
Are obsessed with understanding root causes, not just patching symptoms.
Believe in turning repeated manual workflows into reliable tools, automation, and scalable operating practices.

Enjoy working behind the scenes to make things “just work” for millions of fans.

We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value


Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.

About the job

About The Team

The Touring Buyer Experience (TBEX) team owns the end-to-end touring experience across web, iOS, and Android. We work as a cross-platform product engineering team with shared ownership of the customer experience, partnering across functions to build seamless, measurable experiences that help more customers move confidently through their home-buying journey. We are also deeply AI-forward in how we build with standard AI-assisted coding across the team, shipping across all parts of the stack with on-call and cross-stack ownership.

About The Role

This is not a standard Senior Software Development Engineer role. We’re looking for a mobile product builder who can take an ambiguous idea and turn it into a shipped, instrumented, and continuously improving customer experience. In this role, you’ll partner closely with product, design, and engineering peers to shape solutions, build across mobile and supporting services when needed, and use AI-assisted tools as part of day-to-day development while remaining accountable for quality, correctness, customer experience, and results.

You Will Get To


Turn ambiguous product ideas into clear scope, technical plans, tradeoffs, and success metrics. 
Build and improve mobile experiences across iOS and Android, contributing to backend services or APIs when needed. 
Partner closely with product, design, data, and engineering teammates to shape solutions and challenge assumptions. 
Balance cross-platform consistency with thoughtful platform-specific user experience decisions. 
Ship features with the right testing strategy, rollout plan, monitoring, and rollback safeguards. 
Use production signals, customer behavior, and metrics to learn from launches and improve the experience over time. 
Raise the quality bar through design feedback, code reviews, mentoring, and strong day-to-day engineering practices. 


This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are


You have significant experience building and shipping production mobile applications on iOS and/or Android. 
You are comfortable working across the stack, including mobile clients, APIs, services, and data considerations, when needed to deliver outcomes. 
You have experience supporting production systems, participating in on-call rotations, and using observability and operational signals to guide improvements. 
You have a track record of owning features end to end, from ambiguous problem definition through launch and post-launch iteration. 
You bring strong technical, product, and business judgment, and can connect engineering decisions to customer and company impact. 
You collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners and communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including in asynchronous environments. 
You have depth in one mobile platform and working familiarity with the other, with the ability to reason about cross-platform experiences and backend-connected issues. 
You are comfortable using AI-assisted development tools in day-to-day work while maintaining accountability for quality, correctness, and customer experience. 
Here at Zillow - we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences. 


Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.

If you have a disability or special need that requires reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants will be considered for employment based on their qualifications and ability to perform the functions of the position, without discrimination and in accordance with applicable law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. About the job

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer - SRE

Location: Guadalajara, Mexico, Hybrid

This is a hybrid opportunity and can be worked from in Guadalajara. Candidates must be based in Guadalajara.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our Senior Software Engineer will be pivotal to our company's success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing team in Mexico. We are looking for experienced Senior Software Engineers who can help realize Salesloft's vision with their passion and proven track record of excellence and innovation. We are looking for engineers who are passionate about their work and who thrive working on leading-edge cloud-based technologies to develop ground-breaking AI-driven enterprise-grade applications.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible to -


Design and implement solutions to improve availability and resiliency of Salesloft's services
Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure and containerized environments using Terraform and Kubernetes, while developing automated CI/CD pipelines to streamline application delivery and infrastructure deployments.
Improve operational maturity by defining and implementing SLIs, SLOs, enable faster detection, and isolation of failures and proactively work to mitigate them
Collaborate on sustainable incident response, retrospectives, and identifying opportunities to improve user experience


You will be responsible for building and managing critical third-party services in our software stack, influencing system design, building fault tolerance and disaster recovery capabilities, optimizing systems to improve efficiency. You will participate in implementation of integrating these services to solve large-scale problems, and ensure problem-free, reliable and efficient functioning of these components.

Our teams are empowered and expected to help realize Salesloft's vision via active development and collaboration with our engineering partners.

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to work on an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking Senior Software Engineer who would be Working on cutting-edge technologies alongside a highly motivated and skilled team eager to learn and grow together

If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Software Engineer is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Salesloft's Infrastructure team builds systems and tools to enable engineering velocity in a reliable manner, partnering with engineering teams to establish standards, improve reliability, and increase cost-efficiency.

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired.

This is a great opportunity to make a massive impact on scaling cloud infrastructure to meet the high demand and rapid growth of both users and workload per user. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to define and design solutions that meet our business needs for availability, performance, and reliability.

THE SKILL SET:


5+ years of relevant experience building distributed systems on a public cloud (AWS, GCP)
Proven DevOps & Cloud experience using Terraform | Kubernetes | CI/CD | Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Certifications: CKA or CKS (preferred)
Foundation in software application design and system internals
Collaborate effectively with other engineers to solve most complex technical problems. This involves mentoring, peer reviews, participating in technical design reviews
Excellent troubleshooting and problem solving skills

Our specialty portfolio includes starch-based texturizers, clean and simple ingredients, plant-based proteins, sugar reduction and specialty sweeteners, and food systems. Desarrollar, entrenar y optimizar modelos de Machine Learning y NLP, participando en casos de uso predictivos, automatización y análisis inteligente de información. 
Diseñar e implementar agentes, copilots y experiencias conversacionales utilizando plataformas como Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI y frameworks de desarrollo especializados. 
Construir automatizaciones inteligentes integrando modelos de IA Generativa, APIs de LLMs, herramientas de Document AI y procesos de negocio. 
Integrar soluciones de IA con APIs, bases de conocimiento, vector stores y sistemas corporativos, asegurando una correcta comunicación entre plataformas. 
Aplicar técnicas de Prompt Engineering, RAG y orquestación de agentes para mejorar la precisión, contexto y desempeño de las soluciones. 
Ejecutar pruebas funcionales y de desempeño, identificar oportunidades de optimización y participar en la estabilización de modelos y agentes en producción. 
Explorar nuevas tecnologías, frameworks y tendencias de Inteligencia Artificial, proponiendo alternativas que puedan generar valor para el negocio. 


Perfil


Ingeniería en Tecnologías de Información, Ciencias Computacionales, Software, Inteligencia Artificial, Matemáticas Aplicadas, Electrónica o carrera afín. 
0 a 2 años de experiencia desarrollando soluciones relacionadas con Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning o desarrollo de software. 
También consideramos recién egresados con proyectos demostrables a través de GitHub, proyectos académicos, hackathons, prácticas profesionales, open source o proyectos personales. 
Inglés intermedio–avanzado. 


Conocimientos técnicos


Python aplicado al desarrollo de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial. 
Fundamentos de Machine Learning, Deep Learning y NLP. 
IA Generativa, LLMs y Prompt Engineering. 
Desarrollo y orquestación de agentes de IA. 
Integración y consumo de APIs de LLMs. 
Técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). 
Frameworks como PyTorch, LangChain, Semantic Kernel o similares. 
Plataformas de IA como Azure AI y Microsoft Copilot Studio. 
Conocimientos de Docker y CI/CD. 
Uso de herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA como GitHub Copilot. 


Será un plus


Contar con un portafolio de proyectos o GitHub donde podamos conocer soluciones que hayas desarrollado. 
Haber integrado APIs de OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude u otros modelos de lenguaje. 
Experiencia construyendo chatbots, agentes, copilots o automatizaciones con IA. 
Certificaciones relacionadas con Azure AI, Machine Learning, Copilot Studio o frameworks de Inteligencia Artificial. 


Buscamos personas con curiosidad, capacidad para aprender rápidamente y muchas ganas de construir, experimentar y llevar soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial a producción.

Si quieres desarrollar tecnología que impacte directamente en nuestros clientes, socios y operación, H-E-B es tu lugar.

En H-E-B México promovemos una cultura de diversidad, equidad e inclusión, donde todas las personas tienen las mismas oportunidades para desarrollarse y crecer. Nuestros procesos de selección se llevan a cabo con base en las competencias, experiencia y potencial de cada persona, sin distinción por género, edad, origen, condición, orientación, identidad o cualquier otra característica personal. Creemos que diferentes perspectivas, experiencias y formas de pensar nos hacen mejores y nos permiten seguir construyendo un lugar donde todas las personas puedan ser, pertenecer y aportar lo mejor de sí mismas.

description:
About the job

Your Team Responsibilities

Inside Sales Specialist – Sustainability & Climate

MSCI is looking for a motivated and commercially minded Inside Sales Specialist to help accelerate the growth of our Sustainability & Climate business, including our Carbon Markets solutions, across the Americas.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who wants to build expertise at the intersection of sustainability, climate, financial markets, and technology while developing a career in a client-facing commercial role.

You’ll play an important role in identifying and developing new business opportunities across a diverse range of client segments, including asset managers, wealth managers, banks, and corporates. Working alongside MSCI’s Sustainability & Climate Sales Specialists, you’ll engage prospective and existing clients, understand their evolving sustainability and climate needs, introduce relevant MSCI solutions, and help turn opportunities into long-term client relationships.

The role offers significant exposure across MSCI, with close collaboration across Sales, Product, Marketing, Client Service, Operations, Legal, and Finance.

https://careers.msci.com/life-at-msci

Your Key Responsibilities

What You’ll DoDrive New Business & Build Pipeline


Identify and engage prospective clients across key segments in the Americas through targeted prospecting and lead-generation activities.
Build relationships with new contacts and help expand MSCI’s presence within existing client organizations.
Qualify opportunities by understanding client needs, priorities, and use cases, and connecting them with relevant MSCI Sustainability & Climate solutions.
Initiate new opportunities, secure prospect meetings, and partner with Sales Specialists to execute account and territory strategies.
Manage a defined commercial target aligned with the broader Sustainability & Climate sales organization.


Engage & Educate Clients


Participate in meetings with prospective and existing clients to discuss sustainability and climate trends, evolving client needs, and MSCI’s latest solutions and capabilities.
Support pre-sales activities by providing relevant product information, sample data, analysis, and materials to help clients evaluate MSCI solutions.
Develop strong knowledge of MSCI’s Sustainability & Climate product suite, methodologies, and use cases to confidently address client questions and identify opportunities.
Help uncover additional needs within existing relationships and introduce solutions that can deliver greater value to clients.


Turn Market Insights into Commercial Opportunities


Partner with Marketing on targeted campaigns, prospecting initiatives, and lead-generation programs.
Conduct market, competitor, and prospect research to identify emerging opportunities and priority client segments.
Support campaign execution and tracking, translating market intelligence into actionable sales opportunities.


Own & Accelerate the Sales Process


Help drive opportunities through the full internal sales cycle, ensuring key steps and stakeholders remain aligned and deals continue moving forward.
Coordinate across Product, Legal, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Client Service to support successful deal execution and closure.
Maintain strong pipeline discipline using CRM tools such as Salesforce, including forecasting, opportunity management, activity tracking, and pipeline hygiene.
Track and communicate key commercial metrics, including leads generated, meetings scheduled, conversion rates, and pipeline value.


What Success Looks Like

You’ll thrive in this role if you are curious, proactive, commercially driven, and energized by engaging with clients. You enjoy opening doors, building relationships, learning complex products, and turning client needs into opportunities.

You’ll have the opportunity to deepen your knowledge of the rapidly evolving sustainability and climate landscape while gaining hands-on experience across the full commercial lifecycle from identifying a prospect and starting the conversation to helping progress and close an opportunity.

Most importantly, you’ll be part of a collaborative team focused on expanding MSCI’s Sustainability & Climate business and helping clients navigate some of the most important investment and business challenges shaping global markets today.

Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a commercially minded, curious, and proactive professional who is excited to build expertise in sustainability, climate, and carbon markets while developing strong client relationships and driving business growth.


Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Environmental Science, Sustainability, or a related field. An advanced degree, such as an MBA or master’s in Sustainability, Climate Science, or a related discipline, is a plus.
2–4 years of experience in sales, inside sales, business development, or another client-facing commercial role. Experience with sustainability, climate risk, carbon markets, financial services, or data and analytics solutions is highly valued.
Demonstrated experience with prospecting, outbound client engagement, lead generation, and opportunity qualification.
Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex, technical, or data-driven concepts into clear and compelling client conversations.
A proactive and organized approach, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively across teams.
Commercially driven and comfortable working toward revenue goals, pipeline targets, forecasts, and performance metrics.
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high-quality sales processes and CRM data.
Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, as well as Microsoft Excel and/or other analytics and productivity tools.
Interest in using AI and emerging technologies to work smarter and more effectively. Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or Claude is a plus.


About MSCI

What we offer you


Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.


At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

MSCI Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. It is the policy of the firm to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy (including unlawful discrimination on the basis of a legally protected parental leave), veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. MSCI is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please email Disability.Assistance@msci.com and indicate the specifics of the assistance needed. Please note, this e-mail is intended only for individuals who are requesting a reasonable workplace accommodation; it is not intended for other inquiries.

To all recruitment agencies

MSCI does not accept unsolicited CVs/Resumes. Please do not forward CVs/Resumes to any MSCI employee, location, or website. MSCI is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited CVs/Resumes.

Note on recruitment scams

We are aware of recruitment scams where fraudsters impersonating MSCI personnel may try and elicit personal information from job seekers. Read our full note on careers.msci.com

The Program Management team drives clarity and operational excellence across Studio Zs creative work.

At every level of the team, we're focused on making great work happen-managing projects with rigor, keeping communication clear, and ensuring the team is always set up to execute at its best. This role sits within the PM team as a key execution partner, directly supporting the Senior Program Manager and enabling smooth, high-quality delivery across a diverse portfolio of creative work

Zillow Group is looking for a Program Manager to join the Studio Z Program Management team, reporting to the Senior Manager, Program Management. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone who thrives in the day-to-day rhythm of creative production and brings structure, clarity, and care to every project they touch.

This Program Manager is the day-to-day operational backbone for a subset of Studio Z's creative portfolio. Reporting to the Senior Program Manager, this role keeps projects moving from brief through delivery-managing timelines, communications, and production logistics across a mix of campaign deliverables. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented, proactive executor who brings calm and structure to a fast-moving creative environment, and who is excited to grow their PM skills in a high-performing, cross-functional team.

You will have the opportunity to:


Use creative problem solving skills to deliver results in a fast-moving, innovative environment
Guide work toward the best possible outcome, with an eye toward team and business priorities
Participate in and help shape an evolving process rollout across our team and larger marketing Organization
Grow your program management skills in a dynamic creative environment, with increasing exposure to resourcing planning, operational reporting, and process improvement over time. 


As a Program Manager you will:

Develop project plans and briefing documents in partnership with Account that clearly outline deliverables, project approach, and milestones

Ensure operational systems (JIRA, Google forecasting sheets, and DAM) are rigorously maintained

Actively adopt Al tools and productivity solutions that reduce manual effort and improve day-to-day workflow efficiency

Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

5+ years of program management, creative operations, or campaign production experience
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Experience working with creative teams (designers, copywriters, editors, etc)
Collaborative mindset, a desire to get the best work from teams
Eye for efficiency and creative problem solving
Project Management tool experience a plus

Curiosity about Al and emerging tools, with a drive to embed smarter workflows that expand team capacity

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

3+ years

description:
About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Associate Specialist, Cross-Border Payment Operations

Overview:

Support the daily operations of our payment processes, ensuring the documented data is accurate. The candidate should have a foundational understanding of the payments industry and have a proactive approach to operational tasks.

Responsibilities:


 Assist in the daily operational task of collating data on the payout partners and ensuring accuracy and timeliness
 Monitor transaction flows to identify and address issues promptly
 Identify and resolve payment-related issues and discrepancies, escalating complex cases as needed
 Accurately enter and maintain transaction data in relevant systems
 Assist customer service teams with payment-related inquiries and escalations, providing timely and accurate information
 Perform specific and time-boxed tasks in support of business goals to deliver new existing products
 Draft and contribute to the development of internal and external implementation documents and process flows
 Support initiatives aimed at improving payment processes and operational efficiency



Experiences And Qualifications:


 Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to communicate effectively in verbal and written interactions with global stakeholders.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including intermediate Excel skills.
 Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize workload, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
 Minimum of 3 years of experience in payment operations, payment processing, banking back-office operations, or financial services operations.
 Experience in the payments industry, particularly in cross-border payments, international money transfers, or remittance services, is highly desirable.
 Experience working in banks, fintechs, payment processors, or other financial institutions is preferred.

About the job

Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

Gracenote, a Nielsen company, provides music, video, and sports content along with technologies to the world's hottest entertainment products and brands, which is also a global standard for music and video recognition which is supported by the largest source of entertainment data. Gracenote features descriptions of more than 200 million tracks, TV listings for 85+ countries, and statistics from 4,500 sports leagues and competitions.

We are presently looking for a Customer Care Technical Support Specialist to provide day-to-day support to new and existing customers. In this position, the lead will monitor and mentor a team of customer care specialists and assist with workload and escalation activities. Activities require working with internal cross-functional technical groups and external customers business and engineering teams to drive successful delivery of customer implementations and proactively ensure the on-going success of customer accounts.

Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Mentorship: Monitor daily queue management, assist with workload distribution in Salesforce/Zendesk, and mentor team members to support department performance and skill development.
Account & Stakeholder Management: Serve as the main point of contact and Subject Matter Expert (SME) for key customer accounts, leading client meetings and cross-functional collaborations with Sales and Technical teams.
Technical Support & Escalations: Diagnose, troubleshoot, and prioritize complex product issues, effectively escalating critical problems to internal engineering and technical staff when necessary.
Process & Project Management: Coordinate special projects, maintain detailed documentation (agendas, minutes, action items), and participate in on-call support rotation to ensure seamless 24/7 coverage.


Qualifications


Associates or Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline
Degree in a technical discipline with 5+ years of customer-facing experience leading accounts, handling escalations, and using tools like Salesforce, Zendesk, and Google/Microsoft Suites (multilingual skills in French or Portuguese a plus).
Basic knowledge of custom software applications used at the Gracenote Queensbury NY office is helpful.
French and or Portuguese language skills are a plus.


Additional Information

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Nielsen is committed to maintaining a work environment free from any form of discrimination and harassment. Nielsen prohibits conduct that has the purpose or effect of interfering with terms or conditions of employment, or that creates an intimidating, hostile, or offensive work environment based on: race, skin color/national or ethnic origin/ancestry, religion/creed, physical or mental disability/medical condition/genetic information, pregnancy, marital status, sex/gender, gender identity/gender expression/sexual orientation, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
