description:
About the job



About Epiroc:

Epiroc is a multinational company with a presence in 150 countries; which with innovative technology, develops and provides safe and state-of-the-art equipment, such as drilling machinery and construction tools for use in surface and underground mining.

It also offers world-class after-sales services and solutions for automation, digitalization and electrification.

Life at Epiroc

By joining our team, you will be part of a group of knowledgeable and helpful colleagues who live by our core values: collaboration, commitment and innovation.

The work environment in the mining and construction industries presents unique and interesting challenges that you will not find in other industries.

Our culture is characterized by care for work-life balance, professional development, global career opportunities, and an outstanding benefits package.

Customer Service Chief | Mexico City or Zacatecas

About The Role

We are looking for a Customer Service Chief with a strong customer and results-oriented mindset, proven team leadership experience, and the ability to manage the complete customer service cycle — from quotations and order placement through invoicing, delivery, backorder follow-up, and customer claim resolution.

This role will be key to strengthening customer relationships, ensuring operational excellence, and continuously improving service levels and the overall customer experience.

The position can be based in Mexico City or Zacatecas, Mexico.

Your Mission

Lead the Customer Service operation and develop a high-performing, collaborative team while ensuring an excellent and consistent customer experience.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Logistics, Supply Chain, Service Center, and Finance, translating customer needs into effective operational execution and using data, KPIs, and customer insights to drive improvements.

Main Responsibilities


 Lead, develop, and organize the Customer Service team according to customer and business priorities.
 Oversee the complete customer service cycle, including quotations, purchase orders, order management, invoicing, deliveries, backorders, credit notes, and customer claims.
 Maintain proactive communication with key customers regarding orders, delivery dates, backorders, and commitments.
 Manage and monitor customer orders through M3/ERP, ensuring accuracy and appropriate follow-up throughout the order lifecycle.
 Prepare and present weekly and monthly reports covering order intake, invoicing, open orders, backorders, and forecast performance.
 Define, monitor, and improve Customer Service KPIs, SLAs, and service-level metrics.
 Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on customer experience and operational efficiency.
 Drive NPS, customer loyalty, and Customer Experience initiatives, translating customer feedback into actionable improvements.
 Partner with Sales, Logistics, Supply Chain, Service Center, and Finance to ensure effective execution and customer satisfaction.
 Ensure appropriate traceability, follow-up, and timely resolution of customer complaints and claims.
 Support forecasting, budgeting, and financial closing activities related to Customer Service operations.
 Promote collaboration across functions and a strong customer-focused culture.


What We Are Looking For


 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, International Business, Marketing, Electromechanical Engineering, or a related field.
 Ideally 4+ years of experience in Customer Service, Customer Operations, Order Management, Sales Operations, Supply Chain, or a related function.
 Previous experience leading teams or coordinating Customer Service operations.
 Experience in B2B environments, ideally within mining, construction, heavy equipment, industrial equipment, spare parts, aftermarket, or technical services.
 Experience with mining and construction equipment, spare parts, services, or technical solutions will be highly valued.
 Solid understanding of Order-to-Cash processes, including quotations, purchase orders, invoicing, credit notes, and backorders.
 Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Logistics, Supply Chain, and Finance.
 Strong Excel skills and experience with ERP and CRM systems. Knowledge of M3 and Power BI is an advantage.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and KPIs to support decisions.
 Effective communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.
 Continuous improvement and results-oriented mindset.
 Intermediate English, with the ability to communicate effectively in a business environment.


Location

This position can be based in Mexico City or Zacatecas, Mexico.

Bring Your Unique Perspective

We believe diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives make stronger teams.

If you do not meet every requirement listed above but believe your experience, skills, and motivation could contribute to this role, we encourage you to apply. We would like to hear from you.

It all starts with people. The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com

About the job



About Epiroc:

Epiroc is a multinational company with a presence in 150 countries; which with innovative technology, develops and provides safe and state-of-the-art equipment, such as drilling machinery and construction tools for use in surface and underground mining.

It also offers world-class after-sales services and solutions for automation, digitalization and electrification.

Life at Epiroc

By joining our team, you will be part of a group of knowledgeable and helpful colleagues who live by our core values: collaboration, commitment and innovation.

The work environment in the mining and construction industries presents unique and interesting challenges that you will not find in other industries.

Our culture is characterized by care for work-life balance, professional development, global career opportunities, and an outstanding benefits package.

Customer Service Chief | Mexico City or Zacatecas

About The Role

We are looking for a Customer Service Chief with a strong customer and results-oriented mindset, proven team leadership experience, and the ability to manage the complete customer service cycle — from quotations and order placement through invoicing, delivery, backorder follow-up, and customer claim resolution.

This role will be key to strengthening customer relationships, ensuring operational excellence, and continuously improving service levels and the overall customer experience.

The position can be based in Mexico City or Zacatecas, Mexico.

Your Mission

Lead the Customer Service operation and develop a high-performing, collaborative team while ensuring an excellent and consistent customer experience.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Logistics, Supply Chain, Service Center, and Finance, translating customer needs into effective operational execution and using data, KPIs, and customer insights to drive improvements.

Main Responsibilities


 Lead, develop, and organize the Customer Service team according to customer and business priorities.
 Oversee the complete customer service cycle, including quotations, purchase orders, order management, invoicing, deliveries, backorders, credit notes, and customer claims.
 Maintain proactive communication with key customers regarding orders, delivery dates, backorders, and commitments.
 Manage and monitor customer orders through M3/ERP, ensuring accuracy and appropriate follow-up throughout the order lifecycle.
 Prepare and present weekly and monthly reports covering order intake, invoicing, open orders, backorders, and forecast performance.
 Define, monitor, and improve Customer Service KPIs, SLAs, and service-level metrics.
 Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on customer experience and operational efficiency.
 Drive NPS, customer loyalty, and Customer Experience initiatives, translating customer feedback into actionable improvements.
 Partner with Sales, Logistics, Supply Chain, Service Center, and Finance to ensure effective execution and customer satisfaction.
 Ensure appropriate traceability, follow-up, and timely resolution of customer complaints and claims.
 Support forecasting, budgeting, and financial closing activities related to Customer Service operations.
 Promote collaboration across functions and a strong customer-focused culture.


What We Are Looking For


 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, International Business, Marketing, Electromechanical Engineering, or a related field.
 Ideally 4+ years of experience in Customer Service, Customer Operations, Order Management, Sales Operations, Supply Chain, or a related function.
 Previous experience leading teams or coordinating Customer Service operations.
 Experience in B2B environments, ideally within mining, construction, heavy equipment, industrial equipment, spare parts, aftermarket, or technical services.
 Experience with mining and construction equipment, spare parts, services, or technical solutions will be highly valued.
 Solid understanding of Order-to-Cash processes, including quotations, purchase orders, invoicing, credit notes, and backorders.
 Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Logistics, Supply Chain, and Finance.
 Strong Excel skills and experience with ERP and CRM systems. Knowledge of M3 and Power BI is an advantage.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and KPIs to support decisions.
 Effective communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.
 Continuous improvement and results-oriented mindset.
 Intermediate English, with the ability to communicate effectively in a business environment.


Location

This position can be based in Mexico City or Zacatecas, Mexico.

Bring Your Unique Perspective

We believe diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives make stronger teams.

If you do not meet every requirement listed above but believe your experience, skills, and motivation could contribute to this role, we encourage you to apply. We would like to hear from you.

It all starts with people. The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. To succeed, we need to speed up the shift towards more sustainable mining and construction industries. We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. In Epiroc we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent valuing authenticity and unique perspectives, driving our spirit of innovation. We foster an inclusive culture where diversity isn't just a goal but a part of our values and way of working. This is how we do business for a sustainable future.  Learn more at www.epiroc.com

description:
About the job

Hey there — yeah, you!




HomeHop is a fast-growing short-term rental management company (think Airbnb & VRBO), and we're on the hunt for a friendly, quick-thinking individual to be the voice our guests hear when they reach out. We started with a handful of properties and now manage 140+ short-term rentals across the Midwest USA… and we're still just getting started!




If you love solving problems, thrive when things move fast, and get a little thrill from checking things off a list — keep reading.




What you'll actually be doing

You'll be our guest's go-to person. Someone messages asking where to park, how the hot tub works, or whether they can check in early? You've got them — warm, fast, and helpful every time. Guest messaging is a big part of this role… but it's not the whole role.




Because we're a startup, no two shifts look the same. One minute you're smoothing over a booking question, the next you're helping the team knock out a random task that keeps the whole machine running. We wear a lot of hats around here, and we're looking for someone who's happy to grab one and jump in.




A taste of the day-to-day:

Chatting with guests across Airbnb, VRBO, and our direct booking channels — keeping it prompt, professional, and genuinely friendly
Handling reservations, questions, and the occasional "help, I locked myself out" moment
Coordinating with cleaning and maintenance crews to keep stays running smoothly
Jumping in on all kinds of team tasks and projects as we grow — flexibility is the name of the game
Keeping notes and records tidy so nothing slips through the cracks
Using critical thinking when problems with guests arise




The schedule:

Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Monday 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST
You'll need to work on American holidays (guests travel most when everyone else is off)
5 days of PTO to start




You'll fit right in if you…

Write like a real, warm human — clear, kind, and typo-free
Stay cool under pressure and can juggle a few things at once
Are tech-savvy and comfortable bouncing between apps and platforms
Have experience with short-term rentals or Airbnb (a big plus!)
Are based in Mexico and ready to work fully remote
Actually like helping people




Why HomeHop?

We're a small, scrappy, supportive team that believes work should be fun — not a corporate snooze-fest. We move fast, we back each other up, we celebrate wins, and there's real room to grow as we do!




Ready to hop in?

Hit apply and tell us a little about yourself. We can't wait to meet you!!

About the job

Company Description

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

Job Description

We are looking for a Market Research Operations Analyst to help manage survey data, maintain media station databases, perform rigorous quality control, and engage directly with station stakeholders. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment where precision meets problem-solving, this role is for you!

As a Market Research Operations Analyst, you will play a critical role in maintaining the accuracy, reliability, and timeliness of Nielsen data. You will bridge research operations, data entry, quality control, and stakeholder communication—ensuring high standards across all deliverables.

Key Responsibilities


Data Coding & Quality Control: Review open-ended survey responses using defined logic; conduct rigorous checks on databases and downstream outputs to identify and fix data discrepancies.

Operations & Workflow Management: Track daily production tasks, manage support tickets/escalations, and meet strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and delivery deadlines.
Process Improvement: Collaborate with internal teams to share best practices and propose ideas to streamline workflows, quality controls, and systems.

Attention to Detail: Proven ability to consistently execute rule-based work with high accuracy.
Analytical Skills: Aptitude for spotting data trends, identifying discrepancies, and communicating clear recommendations.
Communication: Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills for managing outbound calls and internal updates.
Technical Skills: Basic computer proficiency with Google Workspace or comparable desktop productivity applications.
Work Style: Calm under pressure, highly adaptable to new technologies/rules, and comfortable balancing urgent requests with high-volume production tasks.


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of U.S. geography and the media landscape (TV, radio, streaming).
Prior experience in survey response coding, market research, or database maintenance.
Familiarity with ticketing, workflow, or case-management tracking tools.
External client or station operator communication experience.

title: Gerente de Mercadotecnia
description:
About the job

Planear, dirigir y ejecutar la estrategia integral de mercadotecnia para los desarrollos habitacionales de la empresa, abarcando desde la fase de preventa, construcción y venta activa, hasta la liquidación de la última unidad. Su misión es asegurar un flujo constante de demanda efectiva, posicionamiento de marca y optimización del presupuesto, trabajando en mancuerna con el equipo comercial para garantizar el cumplimiento de las metas de venta de cada desarrollo. 




Diseñar el branding, concepto y estrategia integral de los desarrollos inmobiliarios, asegurando su ejecución y evolución durante todo el ciclo de vida del proyecto (desde la preventa hasta la venta de la última unidad). Esto incluye el diseño e implementación continua de estrategias y ajustes en campañas publicitarias para fortalecer la comercialización en cada etapa, resolver bajas de ritmo de venta y acelerar la liquidación del inventario final.




Crear, supervisar y optimizar campañas digitales (Meta Ads, Google Ads) y tradicionales para la generación continua de leads calificados. Seguimiento al CRM comercial para asegurar la conversion efectiva de prospectos citas y ventas. Explotación y análisis del CRM para efectividad de campañas Gestión y segmentación de bases de datos (Cartera de Clientes y Prospectos) Coordinar materiales comerciales (renders, recorridos virtuales, brochures, showrooms y casas muestra). Impulsar iniciativas de alto impacto (eventos de apertura, activaciones en sitio, alianzas y ferias inmobiliarias). Administrar y optimizar el presupuesto de marketing, reportando KPIs de desempeño (CPL, CAC, ROI y velocidad de absorción) a la Dirección Comercial y General. Liderar al equipo interno de mercadotecnia




A. Indicadores de Rendimiento (KPIs Cuantitativos): • Costo por Lead (CPL): Optimización y control del costo promedio por prospecto generado por desarrollo y canal digital. • Costo de Adquisición de Cliente (CAC): Eficiencia en la inversión de marketing requerida para concretar la venta de una unidad habitacional. • Tasa de Conversión: Porcentaje de efectividad desde el lead captado hasta la generación de cita en el desarrollo / casa muestra. • Retorno sobre la Inversión (ROI / ROMI): Medición del impacto financiero de las campañas de marketing en relación con las ventas generadas. • Velocidad de Absorción: Cumplimiento de los tiempos y metas de colocación de inventario (casas/lotes) establecidos por la Dirección Comercial para cada desarrollo. B. Entregables Obligatorios: • Plan Estratégico de Lanzamiento y Ciclo de Vida: Entrega de concepto, branding y plan maestro por cada nuevo desarrollo inmobiliario, así como sus actualizaciones tácticas para etapas de liquidación. • Calendario de Campañas y Contenidos: Programa mensual aprobado de pauta publicitaria, materiales comerciales (renders, brochures) y contenidos para redes y canales digitales. • Reporte Ejecutivo Mensual: Informe de analítica de pauta, efectividad de campañas en CRM, análisis de leads y rendimiento de la cartera de prospectos para la Dirección Comercial.

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills and knowledge while working with cutting-edge technology. Join us at Bosch Mobility Aftermarket and help us shape the future of mobility!

Leads a team of product marketing professionals and works cross-functionally with Regional Business Units, Sales, Marketing, Logistics, Customer Service, Business Development, Legal and Finance & Controlling, with a clear focus on achieving market share wins.

The position reports directly to the Global CRM Manager working closely with the Global IT function and Regional CRM business leads and other stakeholders to support an integrated approach to Commercial Excellence.

title: Sales & Data ambassador
description:
About the job

Position

Moët Hennessy is looking for a Sales Ambassador – Off Trade based in Mexico City, responsible for driving sales growth, developing and strengthening strategic relationships with key retail customers, and ensuring excellent commercial execution across the Off Trade channel.

This role combines strong commercial capabilities with a data-driven mindset, leveraging sales analytics, business intelligence tools, and market insights to identify growth opportunities, optimize customer performance, and support strategic decision-making. The Sales Ambassador will play a key role in managing customer performance through KPI analysis, forecasting, business reviews, and commercial planning, while maintaining close relationships with retail buyers and ensuring execution aligned with the company's luxury standards.

The position requires a balance between office-based analytical work and regular customer/store visits within Mexico City to strengthen relationships, identify opportunities, and ensure the successful execution of commercial initiatives

Job Responsibilities

Commercial Management

Develop and execute commercial plans aligned with sales objectives for assigned Off Trade accounts. Drive sales growth and achieve commercial targets through effective account management, assortment optimization, and customer development. Build, manage, and strengthen strategic relationships with key retail customers, distributors, buyers, and decision-makers. Lead commercial negotiations, ensuring profitable agreements, promotional compliance, and alignment with company objectives and brand standards. Identify new business opportunities to increase sales, distribution, visibility, and market share within the retail landscape. Conduct regular customer visits and store checks to review business performance, identify opportunities, and strengthen partnerships. Ensure excellent in-store execution, including visibility, shelf presence, secondary placement, promotional initiatives, and brand standards.

Business Analysis & Data Management

Monitor and analyze sales performance, sell-in, sell-out, depletion, inventory levels, and customer KPIs to identify opportunities and risks. Extract, consolidate, and analyze commercial data from SAP, internal systems, and external data sources (e.g., market research and retail panel data). Develop, maintain, and improve reporting dashboards and scorecards using Power BI and advanced Excel tools. Generate actionable insights through data analysis to support commercial strategies, category performance, and customer development plans. Lead sales forecasting and support demand planning activities through data-driven analysis. Analyze customer profitability, product mix performance, pricing opportunities, and market trends. Prepare monthly business reviews, commercial performance reports, and executive presentations. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all sales reporting processes. Support management decision-making through ad hoc analysis and business recommendations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Trade Marketing, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams. Support annual planning cycles, budget reviews, and commercial initiatives with analytical insights. Drive continuous improvement in reporting processes and business performance tracking. Contribute to Commercial Excellence initiatives through data analysis, KPI monitoring, and performance management

Profile

Education

Bachelor's degree in business administration, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, International Business, or a related field.

Experience

2 to 4 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Excellence, Business Analytics, Sales Operations, Revenue Management, or related commercial roles. Experience within FMCG, premium beverages, consumer goods, luxury brands, retail, or related industries is preferred. Proven experience managing retail customer relationships and delivering commercial results. Strong experience in sales reporting, forecasting, KPI management, and performance analysis. Experience working with distributors and Off Trade / retail customers is highly desirable. Experience using ERP systems, preferably SAP. Demonstrated ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.

Technical Skills

Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, advanced formulas, dashboards, scenario analysis). Advanced Power BI (data modeling, dashboard creation, KPI tracking, visualization, and reporting). SAP knowledge and experience in sales reporting, customer performance analysis, and commercial data management. Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities. Advanced English.

Skills & Competencies

Strong analytical mindset and business acumen. Ability to transform data into strategic actions and business recommendations. Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. Strong commercial and relationship management capabilities. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Results-oriented, proactive, and highly organized. Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills. Ability to influence stakeholders through insights and fact-based recommendations. Strong planning, prioritization, and project management skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Passion for luxury brands and exceptional consumer experiences.

Ideal Profile

A commercially driven professional with strong analytical capabilities who can successfully manage key Off Trade accounts while leveraging data, reporting, and business intelligence tools to drive growth, optimize retail performance, and support strategic decision-making.

About the job

About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. Join our DevelSoper Experience team to design and ship AI-native tooling and agentic workflows that meaningfully accelerate the way EarnIn engineers build, ship, and operate software, and help set a new bar for what engineering productivity looks like. This is a remote position, though it could also be a hybrid role from our Mexico City office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet and cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View headquarters. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position.

Draw on firsthand experience with the friction, toil, and frustrations that slow engineering teams down and use that empathy to build tools and automation that actually solve the right problems.
Drive the design, development, and implementation of tools, systems, and processes that accelerate engineering velocity, reduce manual effort, and raise the quality bar for software delivery.

Document patterns, usage guidance, and best practices so proven workflows can be consistently adopted and extended across the org.

"Our mission is to leverage human power to connect, modernize, and change the world through core moral values and renew the way the business world operates by utilizing the spirit of connection."




What makes you a strong candidate:

You are a novice in Spreadsheets, Project coordination, Construction estimating, CRM.
You have the potential to develop in Residential construction, Monday.com, Cost estimation, Building materials.
English - Conversational.




Responsibilities and more:

Junior Construction Project Coordinator & Estimator




Location: Remote – Latin America

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time

Industry: Residential Construction & Remodeling

Salary: $1050 - $1700 per month




Position Overview:

Our client, an established and expanding residential construction and remodeling company serving the Tampa Bay area, is seeking a meticulous and highly motivated Junior Construction Project Coordinator & Estimator for this entry-level career opportunity. This role is strategically designed for an emerging professional seeking to cultivate a long-term career within the industry through comprehensive,

hands-on training across all facets of residential construction estimating, material costs, and profit margins. As the candidate develops technical proficiency, demonstrates consistent analytical accuracy, and exhibits operational independence, both professional responsibilities and financial compensation will scale accordingly. Operating in collaboration with field contractors, the Junior Estimator will review measurements,

photographic evidence, field notes, and scopes of work compiled during onsite customer consultations to synthesize professional, comprehensive project estimates. Professional fluency in written English and conversational proficiency in spoken English (B2+

level or higher) are mandatory requirements for regular corporate communications.




Key Responsibilities

• Review measurements, photos, contractor notes, and project requirements following onsite appointments.

• Prepare detailed estimates and customer quotes for residential remodeling and construction projects.

• Calculate projected labor, material, subcontractor, and other project costs.

• Coordinate with field contractors and operations to clarify missing or unclear information and ensure estimates accurately reflect the proposed work.

• Update estimates and price change orders when project scope, materials, or customer requirements change.

• Maintain accurate, organized pricing, project details, and estimating records.




Required Qualifications

• Proficiency with spreadsheets and basic cost calculations.

• Ability to work independently while communicating effectively with U.S.-based contractors and leadership.

• Availability to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

• Strong numerical, analytical, and attention-to-detail skills.

• Comfortable with basic project-management, and working in CRM platforms.

• Comfortable working in imperial units (ft/in, sq ft, linear ft).

• Ability to interpret measurements, project notes, photos, and construction-related documentation.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple estimates simultaneously.




Nice-to-haves

• Previous experience in residential construction, remodeling, restoration, general contracting, or a related industry.

• Understanding of construction materials, labor requirements, subcontractor costs, and project margins.

• Familiarity using Monday.com and/or construction estimating or quoting software.

• Familiarity with U.S. construction practices and working with contractors.

• Familiarity with U.S. material pricing (e.g., Home Depot, Lowe's, local suppliers).




What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will consistently turn field information into accurate, timely, and easy-to-understand estimates, typically delivered within 24–48 hours of the site visit, allowing the field team to spend less time on administrative quoting and more time managing customers and projects.




Accuracy is critical. The Estimator must be comfortable asking questions when information is incomplete rather than making assumptions that could affect project cost or profitability.




Your potential leader:

Natalia Kuzminski - Director of Growth & Operations at ROMY | Business Matchmaker | Founder Contratado
